item.title: Chimombe Backs Mnangagwa’s Vision 2030, Says He Holds No Grudge Against Chivayo
item.description: Jailed ZANU PF central committee member Mike Chimombe has voiced his full support for President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s Vision 2030 and the party’s decision to extend his term in office until 2030.

item.title: Welcome to the international year of rangelands and pastoralists, 2026
item.description: Zimbabwe includes many pastoral and agropastoral systems, sharing many of the characteristics of seen in the more classic pastoral settings of East and West Africa.

item.title: Zimstat: Majority of new prisoners were employed
item.description: Employed Zimbabweans now make up the majority of newly admitted prisoners, according to the latest figures released by the Zimbabwe National Statistics Agency (Zimstat), pointing to complex socio-economic drivers of crime beyond unemployment.

item.title: Post-calving struggles leave farmers fearing cattle losses
item.description: Farmers in the Matobo district have raised an alarm over growing difficulties in managing cattle after calving, warning that poor post-birth care is leading to delayed breeding, herd losses, and rising threats to household food security.

item.title: When Heroes Are Buried, Excuses Should Be Buried Too
item.description: There are moments in Zimbabwe when the ceremony is so choreographed that it risks becoming background noise, a familiar script, familiar faces, familiar slogans. And then, every so often, a line slips through that is not merely ceremonial. It is accusatory. It is a mirror.

item.title: Why they fear 2028

item.title: Mining cash drives STI wave in Binga community
item.description: BINGA – A surge in sexually transmitted infections is tightening its grip on the Mlibizi community in Binga District, Matebeleland North, with artisanal mining activity emerging as the dominant driver of recurring cases, health officials say.
